 Latest news Next week in the U.S., some Social Security beneficiaries are to receive their monthly payment for November 2026.
 golibtolibov Social Security Social Security benefits are paid out on Tuesday, November 3: who gets a check?
 William Allen Greg Heilman Update: Oct 29th, 2026 16:21 EDT Share Make us preferred on Google Early next week, certain benefits recipients are due to get their latest monthly payment from the U.S.’s Social Security Administration (SSA). 
 Social Security benefits are to be issued to two groups of beneficiaries , in what is the opening payment run on the SSA’s program schedule for November.
 Who receives Social Security benefits on Tuesday, November 3?
 Some long-term beneficiaries 
 The SSA is to pay out November’s Social Security to recipients who began claiming their monthly benefits before May 1997 .
 Double recipients: Social Security + SSI 
 November 3 is also next month’s Social Security payment date for beneficiaries who concurrently claim Supplemental Security Income (SSI).
 A benefit for certain low-income, low-resource people , SSI differs from Social Security as it is needs-based . Eligibility does not depend on an applicant’s employment history.
 Worth an average of $735.86 per month, per the SSA’s latest statistics, SSI is to be paid out for November on Friday, October 30 . 
 How much are monthly Social Security payments?
 Retirement: $2,034.54 
 Disability: $1,499.41 
 Survivor: $1,636.31 
 Average monthly benefit , according to SSA figures .
 How much will the 2027 COLA be? 
 In an attempt to protest beneficiaries’ purchasing power against the impact of inflation, the SSA is to raise Social Security and SSI payments by 3.6% in 2027 .
 Across all Social Security beneficiaries, this translates into a rise of around $70 per month on the current average payment, which stands at a monthly $1,943.15.
 What other Social Security payment runs are in November?
 Of the U.S.’s 71.6 million Social Security beneficiaries , most are paid on the second, third or fourth Wednesday in each . Under this system, an individual’s designated Wednesday depends on their birthday.
 In November, however, the first date in this payment cycle will be moved forward by 24 hours , as Wednesday 11 is Veterans Day in the U.S.
 Born on 1st-10th of any month: paid on Tuesday, November 10 
 Born on 11th-20th of any month: paid on Wednesday, November 18 
 Born on 21st-31st of any month: paid on Wednesday, November 25 
 NB: If you claim Social Security based on someone else’s work record, the SSA uses the other person’s birthday .
 How does the Social Security Admin pay benefits?
 Direct deposit 
 Social Security recipients can provide the SSA with their banking information using the online “ my Social Security ” toll .
 Direct Express 
 Money can be loaded onto the Direct Express Card , a special debit card for recipients who do not have a bank account. Sign up for Direct Express at 1-800-333-1795 or 1-800-772-1213, or at a Social Security office.
